summary: Pender Public Schools urges the FCC to preserve E-Rate's core funding to ensure reliable, affordable connectivity for students and libraries, citing budgetary concerns and the risk of infrastructure issues and cyber vulnerabilities.

claims.argument: Without E-Rate funding, infrastructure maintenance would be delayed, leading to connectivity issues and increased vulnerability to cyber attacks
claims.evidence_quote: Without this funding, our building maintenance for the infrastructure would be delayed and we would use our networking equipment longer than it should. Our internet connection would not be as up to date as it should for student success (freezing, drop internet due to outdated equipment), and to not provided the best security of devices for our network, opening up our school to be more vulnerable to cyber attacks.
